lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Tuesday graveyard. A different voice. The same fear.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: There's a house — girls go in, they don't, they don't come back out. I'm across the street, I can see—

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: It's 1411 Calder. One door down from the blue one.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Before you can assign a car, the system flags your nearest unit for a 'higher-priority' fender-bender two blocks over and re-routes it on its own. The board balances itself — always away from Calder.

beats.prompt: The only nearby unit just got pulled. What do you do?

choices.label: Override it. Send a car to Calder now.
Note the address. Let the board balance.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A unit rolls to 1411. They find a locked, empty house and an open back door. But it's in the system now — same block, twice. That's a pattern no auto-tag can hide.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: By the time a car frees up, there's nothing to find. You add 1411 to the sticky note. Two addresses now, one street.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You let the board do its job. It balances. The street stays a blur — and you start to wonder who taught it which streets to forget.
